articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
articles.snippet: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

articles.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
articles.snippet: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.

articles.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
articles.snippet: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

articles.title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
articles.snippet: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.

articles.title: Protesters Arrested Outside Nasdaq as Activists Oppose Anthropic IPO Over AI Bubble Risks
articles.snippet: At least four people were arrested outside Nasdaq during Anthropic’s historic IPO, as protesters warned that AI valuations could leave retirement savers exposed to a potential market crash and broader economic losses.
